# Pranit Acharju Newar

> AI Engineer · Full-Stack Developer · IT Instructor

Pranit Acharju Newar, also known as Pranit Acharjunewar-pranit, is an AI engineer and full-stack developer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. He builds LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, deep learning models, and full-stack products with React and Node.js. He is an IT Instructor at G-Tech I.T Solution and holds an IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate.
